assets.name: letting go
assets.description:

There's so much discomfort in letting something go, but if it's time, it's well worth it. All that bunched up energy is released back into the flow of life.

assets.name: breath
assets.description:
*Original: 16"x20"; Acrylic on Canvas*

This one strikes me differently depending on my mood. On one day, it's a man taking a deep breath in the cool winter air. On another, he's taking his last.

assets.name: shadow dance
assets.description:
*24" x 36, Acrylic on Canvas*. 

*Original: [shadowdance](https://sstirling.github.io/assets/shadowdance.jpg) (unlockable)* 


Sometimes I make things how I wish I to see them. Sunlight, during the golden hour, cascading across flora and creating new art, subtly dancing across the canvas on a warm autumn evening. The patterns nature creates are dazzling and hypnotic. Sometimes we're all just a canvas.

assets.name: outflow
assets.description:
**Original: 24"x36" Acrylic on Canvas**

There are few times I feel more serene working with rivers of paint on the canvas. The flow reminds me to keep moving, experiencing. At a time when the world can feel easily unmoored, it's a crucial solace and a guiding hope.
